description: Implementation of an audio decoder thread for Windows platform, managing input buffers, decoding audio samples, and invoking callbacks upon decoding.

classes.name: AudioDecoderThread
classes.description: A thread class responsible for managing audio decoding operations, including input queue management, decoding, and callback invocation.

methods.name: WriteAsMuchAsPossible
methods.description: Attempts to write as many input buffers as possible to the audio decoder from the queue.

methods.name: ReadAllDecodedAudioSamples
methods.description: Reads all available decoded audio samples from the decoder.

methods.name: AudioDecoderThread::QueueInput
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for decoding.

methods.name: AudioDecoderThread::QueueEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: AudioDecoderThread::Run
methods.description: Main thread loop that processes input buffers, decodes audio, and invokes callbacks.

methods.name: AudioDecoderThread::TransferPendingInputTo
methods.description: Transfers pending input buffers from the internal queue to a provided destination.
